Chapter 1 of 8 • Getting Started

Overview, Editions & Hybrid .rsip Architecture

RaggieSoft Installer Studio (Install Without Limits) is a zero-dependency native Win32 C++20 packaging suite targeting Windows 11 x64 and ARM64. Every tool in the suite compiles directly with cl.exe /MT against stock Windows 11 SDK system libraries (msi.dll, cabinet.dll, gdiplus.dll, and Msftedit.dll) so neither your developer workstation nor your customer's PC needs external frameworks pre-installed.

Five Native Binaries in One Suite

  • InstallerStudio.exe: 12-view Tree-First native Win32 Visual IDE and 6 guided Dark/Light AeroWizards with a 100% comment-preserving AST.
  • instbuild.exe: Headless CLI compiler, sub-millisecond JSON validator, AI spec emitter, and HTML5 VPAT 2.5 generator.
  • SetupWizard.exe: White-label WCAG 2.2 Level AA external-UI bootstrapper with 11 selectable Wizard Styles, Windows LZMS solid compression, Pre-MSI Runtime Prerequisites, and an authentic Windows Installer SelectionTree.
  • msiprism.exe: Native 64-bit Dark Mode SQL database inspector and differ for .msi, .msm, and .msp packages.
  • RaggieSoftHelp.exe: Zero-dependency native C++20 offline Help Viewer with Named Pipe F1 context navigation, Contents tree, keyword Index, and instant full-text Search.

Official Product Editions (Community, Essentials, Developer & Architect)

RaggieSoft Installer Studio is organized into four editions—with WCAG 2.2 Level AA runtime accessibility, OS Dark/Light/Contrast Themes, 100% publisher-owned VERSIONINFO (zero watermarks), and Dual-Layer Authenticode / Azure Artifact Signing included in every edition:

  • Community Edition (Free — Hobbyists, Solo Creators, EDU & Open Source): Permanently maintains 100% technical feature parity with Architect Edition (Community == Architect)—every compiler engine, RaggieScript, visual dialog designer, .MSM builder, .MSP patcher, .rsis Suite chainer, and VPAT 2.5 report generator is unlocked with zero watermarks.
  • Essentials Edition (Commercial Tier 1): Guided no-code packaging for commercial teams (1 workstation seat): relational .MSI + Universal Setup.exe (x64 & ARM64), Basic Folder/.ZIP Self-Extractor (PackageKind = sfx + %TEMP% Software Installation wrapper with _ISDEL.EXE completion watcher), all 6 AeroWizards & 11 Wizard Styles, Pre-MSI Runtimes, consumption of existing .MSM Merge Modules (does not compile new .MSM files), and Major Upgrades Only (1.0.0 to 1.0.1 mints a fresh ProductCode under your shared UpgradeCode without creating .MSP patches).
  • Developer Edition (Commercial Tier 2): Everything in Essentials plus compiling new .MSM Merge Modules, RaggieScript (.rssc) zero-MSI native scripting & full Engine = native, From-Scratch C++ & 370x270 MSI.DLL Dialog Designers, Visual Studio .slnx & VB6 .vbp Reg-Free COM importers, msiprism.exe, RsUpdate.exe, --emit-winget, and commercial CI/CD build agent rights.
  • Architect Edition (Commercial Tier 3): Everything in Developer plus Multi-Product Unified .rsis Suites (Showcase Studio front-door + dynamic ARPSYSTEMCOMPONENT adoption), .MSP Binary-Delta Patches (RsPatch.exe) & .MST Transforms, Multi-Volume Disk Spanning & msiexec /a Admin Installs, .rswpak On-Demand CDN Packs, and Automated HTML5 VPAT 2.5 Conformance Reports (--emit-vpat).

Hybrid Project Files (.rsip + .rsis + .rsii + .rssc)

  1. .rsip (RaggieSoft Installer Project): Standalone plain-text INI-style manifest describing one installer, self-extractor, or Merge Module. Comments (; and #) survive GUI edits byte-for-byte.
  2. .rsis (RaggieSoft Installer Suite): Optional multi-project workspace grouping multiple .rsip manifests with shared [Variable] tokens, deterministic BuildOrder sorting, and single-UAC Suite chaining.
  3. .rsii (RaggieSoft Installer Include): Optional @include "shared.rsii" header inherited cleanly across projects.
  4. .rssc (RaggieScript — v0.7.0): Curly-brace zero-MSI native scripting language compiling to compact RSWBC1 bytecode—usable either as a 100% standalone setup.rssc project or attached to a .rsip manifest via ScriptFile.
